ai_summary: Advanced Enzyme Technologies Ltd. experienced a challenging Q1 FY27, with marginal 2% year-over-year revenue growth overshadowed by significant sequential declines of 7% in revenue, 19% in EBITDA, and 15% in net profit. This downturn was materially driven by a 7% Y-o-Y decline in the dominant Human Nutrition segment and a substantial 23% sequential drop in core operating profit. A key red flag is that a sharp 80% increase in "Other Income" partially masked the underlying operational weakness, preventing an even steeper decline in reported net profit.
